COMMERCIAL CLARITY

Key Factors Influencing Your Custom Quote

As a direct B2B packaging manufacturer, we calculate transparent wholesale factory quotes based on the following 6 structural variables:

1. Dimensions & Paper Stock (GSM)

Bag size (W × H × D) and paper grammage (120g Kraft vs. 250g Cardboard) determine raw material consumption and die layout.

2. Printing Inks & Surface Coverage

Single spot color vs. full-surface 4-color CMYK printing and inner gusset storytelling alter press setup and ink requirements.

3. Specialty Surface Finishes

Metallic hot stamping foil area, multi-level debossing plates, and soft-touch laminates add specific tooling processes.

4. Handle Material & Assembly

Automated twisted paper handles vs. hand-threaded luxury satin ribbon closures and metal aglet tips involve different assembly techniques.

5. Order Production Quantity

Larger manufacturing runs (3,000 to 10,000+ pieces) substantially reduce per-unit plate-making and machine calibration amortization.

6. Packaging & Shipping Terms

Direct factory delivery available via EXW, FOB (Shenzhen/Guangzhou), DDP Sea Freight, or express air courier right to your door.
